description: Sharper selective consensus agent. It emits predictions only when the saved baseline LSTM, Sent-fallback event gate, selected-blend event gate, and clean regularized context specialist agree with at least 0.30 average confidence.

Wider selective consensus agent. It keeps the baseline LSTM, saved selected blend, both event-gated agents, and clean regularized context specialist in agreement, then emits a prediction when average confidence is at least 0.30.
Selective consensus agent. It only emits a prediction when the boosted context agent, event-gated selected-blend agent, and saved Sent LSTM agree with at least 0.31 average confidence.

Selective consensus agent. It emits predictions only when the Sent-fallback event gate, selected-blend event gate, clean regularized context specialist, and saved Sent LSTM agree with at least 0.31 average confidence.
Selective boosted context agent. It only emits predictions when the boosted context probability is at least 0.19 away from 0.50.
Selective boosted context agent. It only emits predictions when the boosted context probability is at least 0.18 away from 0.50.
Selective boosted context agent. It only emits predictions when the boosted context probability is at least 0.15 away from 0.50.
Selective boosted context agent. It only emits predictions when the boosted context probability is at least 0.14 away from 0.50.
Selective boosted context agent. It only emits predictions when the boosted context probability is at least 0.20 away from 0.50.
Selective event-gated boosted Sent agent. It only emits predictions when the selected probability is at least 0.18 away from 0.50.
Selective event-gated boosted Sent agent. It only emits predictions when the selected probability is at least 0.19 away from 0.50.
Selective event-gated boosted Sent agent. It only emits predictions when the selected probability is at least 0.20 away from 0.50.
Selective event-gated boosted Sent agent. It only emits predictions when the selected probability is at least 0.15 away from 0.50.
Selective boosted context agent. It only emits predictions when the boosted context probability is at least 0.10 away from 0.50.
Selective event-gated boosted Sent agent. It only emits predictions when the selected probability is at least 0.10 away from 0.50.

Full-coverage walk-forward ticker calibration. It keeps the event-gated selected-blend agent as the source model, but recalibrates the decision threshold separately for each ticker using only prior observations for that ticker.
Event-intensity gate that uses the boosted context agent when prior validation selects an active-event threshold, otherwise falls back to the saved raw Sent LSTM.
Event-intensity gate that uses the boosted context agent when active-event validation supports it, otherwise falls back to the saved 25/75 blend.

Gradient-boosting specialist using LSTM probabilities plus text, GDELT, official-event, statement, and theory-agent context. The decision threshold is recalibrated on the immediately previous validation month.

Walk-forward confidence override. The regularized context specialist is used only when its confidence threshold is selected from prior validation months; otherwise the event-gated selected-blend agent is used.
More strongly regularized walk-forward logistic stack using the same clean feature set. This reduces overfitting in the small saved prediction sample.
Walk-forward logistic stack using LSTM probabilities plus market, text, GDELT, official, and statement features. Explicit calendar/regime-window flags are excluded.
Saved benchmark raw Sent LSTM.
Saved benchmark 25% baseline plus 75% Sent blend.
Month-by-month blend weight chosen only from previous saved prediction months.
Walk-forward gradient boosting router using LSTM probabilities plus context features.
Walk-forward random forest router using LSTM probabilities plus context features.
Walk-forward logistic meta model using LSTM probabilities plus context features.
Saved benchmark baseline LSTM.
Full-sample diagnostic ticker calibration. This shows the post-hoc same-amount ceiling when each ticker gets its own threshold chosen from the whole saved result set. It is not deployment-safe.

Full-sample diagnostic confidence override. It uses the clean regularized context specialist when that specialist is at least 0.27 away from 0.50, otherwise the event-gated selected-blend agent is used. The threshold is not walk-forward selected.

Full-coverage diagnostic consensus agent. The event-gated selected blend, clean regularized context specialist, and saved Sent LSTM vote together when they agree with at least 0.17 average confidence; otherwise it falls back to the boosted context agent.
Uses the selected-fallback event gate inside the predefined pre-war and war study windows, and the Sent-fallback event gate elsewhere.
Uses the saved 25/75 blend inside the predefined pre-war window and the clean regularized logistic stack elsewhere.
Uses the saved 25/75 blend inside the predefined pre-war window and the regime-aware logistic stack elsewhere.
Walk-forward logistic stack using all context features, including explicit study-regime timing fields.
Full-sample best blend. This uses the whole saved prediction set and is not deployment-safe.
